title: 第3章 厨房墩子劈柴第4章 蛇形刁手
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
赵寒等矿奴处理完黑狼帮的尸体，又处理起毒蛇帮帮众和矿奴的尸体。
毒蛇帮帮众的尸体，要拖回黑水县的毒蛇帮总帮处理，顺带托运铁矿石。
黑狼帮帮众的尸体，要拖去林中喂野兽。
矿奴的尸体，直接就地焚烧成灰，然后掩埋。
可以说待遇天差地别。
忙完了活后，赵寒也就感觉有些流汗，身体倒不是很累。
黑狼拳入门，加上毕竟做了那么久的矿工，适应性还是有的。
换做之前，扛几具比自己还重的尸体，怕是累得半死。
赵寒的一番下功夫的行为，落在了头目眼里。
“那黑瘦的小子，还有你，你……你们都过来。”
刘刚指了指几个矿奴，都是十来岁到二十来岁，干活麻利积极的。
“刘头目，您找小人们有何吩咐？”
一名嘴巴比较甜的矿奴，弯着腰搓着手笑道。
一副卑躬屈膝小人模样。
“我看你们几个小子干活卖力，正好我毒蛇帮毒龙堂死了这么多帮众，给你们机会让你们入堂。”
刘刚压根没有商量的语气，而是通知。
在他看来，一群泥腿子弯脚杆能进入毒蛇帮，简直就是祖坟冒青烟。
“哎哟，多谢刘头目啊！”
“为毒蛇帮毒龙堂做事，我必赴汤蹈火在所不辞！”
“今后毒蛇帮就是我家了！”

“刘头目若是不嫌弃我，我愿拜刘头目为义父！”
赵寒几人当然求之不得，之前那谄媚的矿奴，更是差点跪地上磕头了。
“好，你们不用去干活了，跟我来吧。”
带着几人离开，期间又挑选了三人，凑够十人足以交差。
“你们都叫什么名字？”
“赵大、李二、张三、李飞、王五……赵寒。”
接下来是安排工作。
刘刚直接按照每个人的第一印象——颜值和肤色、体型来分配工作。
“李二，张三，你俩才来矿场不久，还白白净净的，去‘服侍’堂主，他正缺两个掺茶倒水的。”
李二和张三听闻后脸色大喜，竟然能近距离接触堂主李大龙，这岂不是说未来前途无限。
要是李大龙看他俩顺眼，说不定还能混个头目当当。
content_en:
Zhao Han and other mine slaves finished processing the bodies of the Black Wolf Gang, and then processed the bodies of the Viper Gang members and the mine slaves.
The bodies of the Viper Gang members were to be towed back to the Viper Gang Headquarters in Blackwater County for processing, and the iron ore was to be shipped along with them.
The corpses of the Black Wolf Gang members were to be dragged to the forest to be fed to wild animals.
The bodies of the mining slaves were burned directly to ashes on the spot and then buried.
It can be said that the treatment is very different.
After finishing his work, Zhao Han felt a little sweaty, but his body was not very tired.
An introduction to Black Wolf Fist, and after all, I have been a miner for so long, so I still have some adaptability.
Before doing this, I was afraid that I would be half dead from exhaustion carrying several corpses heavier than myself.
Zhao Han's hard work fell into the eyes of the leader.
"The thin black boy, and you, you...you all come here."
Liu Gang pointed to several mining slaves, all of whom were in their teens to twenties and worked quickly and actively.
"Boss Liu, what are your orders to the little men?"
A mine slave with a sweet mouth bent over and rubbed his hands with a smile.
He looks like a groveling villain.
"I see you guys working hard. It just so happens that my Viper Gang, Poison Dragon Hall, has killed so many members of the Poison Dragon Hall, giving you a chance to join the Hall."
Liu Gang didn't have a discussing tone at all, but informed.
In his opinion, a group of mud-legged people with bent legs and poles can enter the Viper Gang, which is like smoke rising from their ancestral graves.
"Oh, thank you so much, Boss Liu!"
"To work for the Poison Snake Gang Poison Dragon Hall, I will go through fire and water no matter what!"
"The Viper Gang will be my family from now on!"
"If Boss Liu doesn't dislike me, I would like to worship Boss Liu as my adoptive father!"
Of course, Zhao Han and the others couldn't ask for it, and the flattering mine slave before almost knelt down and kowtowed.
"Okay, you don't have to work anymore, come with me."
He left with a few people, and during the process he selected three more people, making up ten people for business.
"What are your names?"
"Zhao Da, Li Er, Zhang San, Li Fei, Wang Wu... Zhao Han."
Next is to arrange the work.
Liu Gang assigns work directly based on everyone's first impression - appearance, skin color, and body shape.
"Li Er, Zhang San, you two have just arrived at the mine not long ago, and you are still clean and fair. Go to 'serve' the hall master. He is short of two tea mixers and water pourers."
Li Er and Zhang San were overjoyed after hearing this. They were able to get up close to the hall leader Li Dalong. Doesn't this mean that the future has unlimited prospects?
If Li Dalong likes them both, he might even be able to become the boss.
